EXP-3540.name: DD-Tier / Event-Gate / Sizing Protection Grid
EXP-3540.description: EXP-3540 (re-scoped per EXP-3510/3520): find the cheapest live-implementable rule that caps V8A drawdown given June was a routine -4% dip amplified by leverage. Grid: sizing (live-like 21.5% vs 10% flat risk of current equity) x equity-DD tiers with TRUE flatten (off / deployed 8-10-12 / tight 4-7-9) x event gates (off / NFP / NFP+FOMC), plus one demoted VIX-exit reference cell. Real engine, offline Polygon marks, real VIX (EXP-3510). Winner selected on 2020-2023, validated untouched on 2024-2026-04.
EXP-3540.notes: Ship gate: test-period portfolio MaxDD <= 10% AND CAGR >= 70% of same-sizing unprotected baseline AND rank-stable (top-5 Calmar both halves). RESULT (2026-07-03): 57/57 cells run. Winner on 2020-2023 Calmar = s100_d479_eoff (10% flat risk + tight 4/7/9 tiers, no event gate): test 2024-2026-04 CAGR 5.3%, MaxDD -4.3%; full-window MaxDD -4.9% vs -9.7% same-sizing / -17.5% live-like unprotected. SHIP GATE: 0/18 cells pass - rank-stability leg fails structurally (train top-5 and test top-5 Calmar sets are disjoint; regime split). Sizing dominates; event gates are a no-op; VIX-30 close-all reference is catastrophic (-42.7% DD).

EXP-3550.name: Continuous Vol-Target Sizing
EXP-3550.description: EXP-3550 (follow-up to EXP-3540): continuous vol-targeted per-stream sizing. Per-trade max-loss/NAV = 21.5% (live-like base) x sigma_target/sigma_ATR20(t-1), engine's causal 20d ATR annualized vol (clip 0.10-1.00). Grid: target {8,12,16}% annualized x bounds {foff=[1%,43%] safety, fon=[5%,21.5%] never-exceed-live}. 18 cells (3 tickers). Base = live VRP stream params, hold-to-expiry, no DD tiers, no event gates (EXP-3540: no-op). Real engine, offline Polygon marks, real VIX (EXP-3510). Hypothesis: continuous sizing reconciles DD<=10% with CAGR>=70% of live-like baseline in BOTH regimes where EXP-3540's discrete tiers could not. Winner on 2020-2023 Calmar, untouched test 2024-2026-04.
EXP-3550.notes: Ship gate: test portfolio MaxDD <= 10% AND test CAGR >= 70% of live-like unprotected baseline (EXP-3540 s215_doff_eoff, reused) AND rank-stable (top-3-of-6 portfolio Calmar in both train and test). Secondary evidence: rank in combined 24-config universe (18 EXP-3540 cells + 6 EXP-3550 configs). RESULT (2026-07-03): HYPOTHESIS REFUTED, 0/6 configs pass the gate. Winner on train Calmar = vt08_fon (8% target, bounds 5-21.5%): test CAGR 5.3% / MaxDD -9.7% - passes DD, fails CAGR leg (needs 9.9% = 70% of live-like 14.2%) and rank. vt12/vt16 have test MaxDD -13.6..-15.3%, WORSE than the unprotected baseline (-9.8%). EXP-3540 winner s100_d479_eoff dominates every vol-target cell on Calmar in both periods (1.07/1.23 vs <=0.49/0.60); combined-24 rank-stable top-5 set still empty. Cause: trailing ATR vol is reactive (de-sizes after damage on a 30DTE hold-to-expiry book), sizes UP in calm regimes exactly when short-put tail risk accumulates, and under-sizes recoveries. Next axis if pursued: anticipatory/implied-vol-conditioned sizing, not trailing realized vol.
